description_en: Invokes the AssociateAclsWithListener operation to associate an access control policy group with a listener
description_zh: 调用AssociateAclsWithListener接口将访问控制策略组（ACL）关联到监听
kebab_example: aliyun ga associate-acls-with-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-ids nacl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --acl-type white --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateAclsWithListener

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the access control policy groups. You can associate up to two access control policy groups
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组ID，最多支持关联2个访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the listener.

Only listeners of the intelligent routing type support the access control feature
parameters.help_zh:
监听ID。

仅智能路由类型监听支持使用访问控制功能
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control type. Valid values:
white: a whitelist. Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the Settings of the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists apply to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access an application. Configuring a whitelist poses business risks. After you configure a whitelist, only IP addresses in the whitelist can access the Global Accelerator listener. If you enable whitelist-based access control but do not add any IP addresses to the access control policy group, the Global Accelerator listener forwards all requests.
black: a blacklist. Requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the Settings of the selected access control policy group are not forwarded. Blacklists apply to scenarios in which you want to block access from specific IP addresses. If you enable blacklist-based access control but do not add any IP addresses to the access control policy group, the Global Accelerator listener forwards all requests
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制类型。取值：
white：仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问全球加速监听。如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则全球加速监听会转发全部请求。
black：来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则全球加速监听会转发全部请求
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: prechecks the request without associating the resources. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the actual request. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会关联资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

AclIds.description_en: The IDs of the access control policy groups

items.description_en: The ID of the access control policy group
